personal.name: Gourav Ojha
personal.bio: I build scalable digital products with modern technologies, combining engineering discipline with thoughtful design to create software that genuinely solves problems.
personal.mission: My mission is to build software that makes a real difference — products that improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and provide lasting value for businesses and users.
personal.aboutIntro: I'm a Computer Science student and Product Engineer who builds complete software products rather than isolated features. I focus on understanding the problem deeply before reaching for a solution.
personal.aboutDetail: I believe engineering is about thinking, designing, experimenting, and continuously improving. Every project I build teaches me something new about architecture, user experience, or the domain itself.
personal.philosophy: AI is transforming how we build software, but it doesn't replace engineering judgment. I use AI to accelerate development while staying focused on system design, code quality, and long-term maintainability.
